leaked_early.details: On February 29, 2016, Alexza disclosed it had entered into a non-binding letter of intent with Ferrer, which was more than 2 months before the May 10, 2016 announcement. Media also reported on 'emergency talks' in March 2016.

notes: Distressed company with only one approved product (ADASUVE) and on the brink of insolvency; the deal, structured as a cash tender offer plus CVRs, was a rescue acquisition by its commercial partner Ferrer after a broad auction failed to yield any other funded bidders.
